thread.title: Fortune's 'World's Most Admired Companies' list includes five from the Charlotte area

author: John Downey
title: Fortune's 'World's Most Admired Companies' list includes five from the Charlotte area
text: – Senior Staff Writer, Charlotte 1:29pm EST Five Charlotte-area companies made it on Fortune magazine’s "World's Most Admired Companies" list for 2019. Bank of America Corp. (NYSE: BAC), Coca-Cola Consolidated (NASDAQ: COKE), Duke Energy Corp. (NYSE: DUK), Lowe’s Cos. Inc. (NYSE: LOW) and Nucor Corp. (NYSE: NUE) made the list. All of the companies are based in Charlotte with the exception of Lowe’s, which has its headquarters nearby in Mooresville. None made the “all star” list , which featured the top 50 companies and was led by Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL). As a result, Fortune did not provide individual rankings for the Charlotte-area companies on the list. But the companies' placements within each's industry group were available. Nucor ranked second among metals companies, behind only Indiana-based Steel Dynamics (NASDAQ: STLD). Bank of Amerca ranked second among megabanks, trailing only JPMorgan Chase (NYSE: JPM). Lowe’s ranked third among specialty retailers. And Duke ranked fifth among electric and gas utilities, while Coca-Cola Consolidated finished seventh among beverage companies. The 500 companies on Fortune 's list were chosen from about 1,500 companies worldwide. Only 10 North Carolina companies and two in South Carolina made the list this year. – Senior Staff Writer, Charlotte 1:29pm EST Deadline: Tuesday, January 22, 2019 2019 Most Admired CEOs Do you know a leader that stands out from the crowd?
